tier_should.rationale: Novel RCT on informal-sector fiscal contract: training reduces participation yet raises verified revenue via sorting. Strong design (randomization, balance, IV), clear contribution. Limitations: single city, partial verification/missing outcomes, mechanism only suggestive. Fits top field journals in development/public finance.

tier_will.rationale: Policy-relevant, counterintuitive RCT with credible identification, but external validity, missing data on revenues, and incomplete mechanism reduce A-journal odds. Realistic placement: Journal of Development Economics, AEJ: Applied, or similar strong field outlets.
